content: Nɔɔ mwɛɛ
te Yinni Gusunɔ u Dɑfidi kuɑ
Ye Yinni Gusunɔ u sinɑ boko Dɑfidi wɔrɑ win yibɛrɛ be bɑ nùn sikerenɛn nɔmɑn di, u derɑ u wɑ̃ɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ u sɔ̃ win yɛnuɔ.
Yerɑ sinɑ boko wi, u Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Nɑtɑni sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, n wee nɑ wɑ̃ɑ diru sɔɔ te bɑ kuɑ kɑ dɑ̃ɑ ɡeɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ sɛduru. Adɑmɑ Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkororu wee tɑ wɑ̃ɑ kuu bekuruɡiru sɔɔ. Amɔnɑ ɑ wɑ.
Mɑ Nɑtɑni u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo ɑ ko nɡe mɛ ɑ ɡɔ̃ru doke kpuro. Domi Yinni Gusunɔ u wɑ̃ɑ kɑ wunɛ.
Ye n kuɑ wɔ̃kuru, yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Nɑtɑni sɔ̃ɔwɑ kɑ̃siru sɔɔ u nɛɛ,
ɑ doo ɑ nɛn sɔm kowo Dɑfidi sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, nɛ Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔmɔ, n ǹ mɔ wiyɑ u koo mɑn diru bɑniɑ mi nɑ kon wɑ̃ɑ.
Domi nɑ ǹ sinɑre diru ɡɑru sɔɔ sɑɑ mìn di nɑ kɑ Isirelibɑ yɑrɑmɑ Eɡibitin di sere n kɑ kuɑ ɡisɔ. Adɑmɑ nɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑwɑ kuu bekuruɡiru sɔɔ.
Bɑɑmɑ mi sɑ dɑ nɛ kɑ Isirelibɑ ɡbɑburɔ, nɑ rɑ ben ɡɑbu ɡɔsiwɑ bɑ n kɑ be bɑ tie kpɑre. Adɑmɑ nɑ ǹ ben ɡoo tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃ɛre n nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ u ǹ mɑn diru bɑniɛ kɑ dɑ̃ɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ sɛduru.
Yen sɔ̃, ɑ doo ɑ Dɑfidi nɛn sɔm kowo sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, nɛ Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni, nɛnɑ nɑ yeni ɡerumɔ. Yɑ̃ɑ kpɑrɑbun diyɑ nɑ nùn wunɑmɑ u n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑn kpɑro.
Nɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ wi bɑɑmɑ kpuro mi u dɑ. Mɛyɑ nɑ mɑɑ nùn win yibɛrɛbɑ dɛrɑ. Mɑ nɑ derɑ u yĩsiru yɑrɑ nɡe tɔn boko duniɑ sɔɔ.
Nɑ Isirelibɑ ɑyeru kuɑ nɑ bu sinɑsiɑ bɑ n kɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi kɑ bɔri yɛndu, kpɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu bu ku rɑɑ mɑɑ se bu bu nɔni sɔ̃ nɡe mɛ bɑ bu kuɑ yellu,
kpɑrobun wɑɑti sɔɔ. Nɑ nùn wɔrɑ win yibɛrɛbɑ kpuron nɔmun di mɑ nɑ nùn wɛ̃rɑbu wɛ̃. Nɛ Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔmɔ, kon nùn ko bwese bɑkɑrun nuuru.
Win sɑɑ yɑ̀ n turɑ u ɡu bɑ nùn sikɑ win bɑɑbɑbɑn sikirɔ, kon win bii turo wunɑ u bɑndu di. Kpɑ n win bɑn ten dɑm sire.
Wiyɑ u koo mɑn diru bɑniɑ u kɑ nɛn yĩsiru bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃, kpɑ n win sinɑ ɡɔnɑ swĩi sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Nɑ kon sɑ̃ɑ win tundo, kpɑ u n mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn bii. Ù n torɑru ɡɑru kuɑ, tɔmbɑ kon de bu nùn so bu sɛɛyɑsiɑ.
Adɑmɑ nɑ ǹ nùn nɛn durom wunɑrimɔ nɡe mɛ nɑ mu Sɔɔlu wunɑri wi nɑ yinɑ mɑ nɑ wi, Dɑfidi ɡɔsɑ.
Win bweseru tɑ ǹ ɡbimɔ. Win bɑndu tɑ ko n mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ win bibun bweseru sɔɔ, kpɑ n ten dɑm sire sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Ye Nɑtɑni u ɡɑri yi kpuro nuɑ u kpɑ, yerɑ u seewɑ u dɑ u Dɑfidi sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔsi kpuro kɑ̃si te sɔɔ.
Dɑfidi u Gusunɔ siɑrɑmɔ
Mɑ Dɑfidi u seewɑ u dɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ, nɑ yɛ̃ mɑ nɑ ǹ sɑ̃ɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu. Nɛn bweserɑ kun mɑɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu turɑ. Kɑ mɛ, ɑ mɑn kuɑ sunɔ Yerusɑlɛmu mini.
Adɑmɑ ɑ ye ɡɑrisi ɡɑ̃ɑ piiminu wunɛn mi. Domi ɑ kpɑm ɡerumɔ nɡe mɛ nɛn bweseru tɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑ siɑ. Mɑ ɑ mɑn ye sɔ̃ɔmɔ, nɛ wi nɑ sɑ̃ɑ tɔn diro.
Yinni, mbɑ kon mɑɑ nun sɔ̃. Domi ɑ mɑn yɛ̃ kɔ.
Wunɛn ɡɑri kɑ mɑɑ wunɛn ɡɔ̃run kĩrun sɑɑbuwɑ ɑ kɑ mɑn ɡɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑ nini kpuro kuɑ. Mɑ ɑ mɑn nu sɔ̃ɔsi.
Gɑ̃ɑnu kpuro ye sɑ nuɑ ɑ kuɑ, ɡeemɑ, yɑ sɔ̃ɔsimɔ mɑ ɑ kpɑ̃. Goo sɑri wi u sɑ̃ɑ nɡe wunɛ. Wunɛ turowɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔ.

Bweseru ɡɑru mɑɑ sɑri nɡe bɛsɛ Isirelibɑ te tɑ koo nɛɛ, ten bũu u tu yɑkiɑmɑ yorun di mɑ u tu yĩsiru kɑ̃ tɑ n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ wiɡiru. Kɑ ɡeemɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑnɑ ɑ sun kuɑ. A mɑɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ mɑɑmɑɑkiɡinu kuɑ wunɛn tem sɔ̃ bɛsɛn wuswɑɑɔ ye ɑ kɑ sun yɑkiɑmɑ Eɡibitiɡibun min di, kɑ bwesenu ɡɑnun nɔmɑn di, kɑ ben bũnun suunu sɔɔn di, kpɑ sɑ n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ wunɛɡibu
mɑm mɑm sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ. Mɑ wunɛ Gusunɔ ɑ kuɑ bɛsɛn Yinni.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, Yinni, ɡɑri yi ɑ ɡeruɑ nɛ kɑ nɛn bweserun sɔ̃, ɑ de yi koorɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
A de wunɛn yĩsiru tu wɔlle suɑrɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ kpɑ bu nɛɛ, wunɛ Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinniwɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn Yinni. Kpɑ ɑ de nɛn bwese kɛrɑ yɑ n bɑndu dii wunɛn wuswɑɑɔ.
Domi wunɛ Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni, wunɛ wi ɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn Yinni, wunɑ ɑ mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ ɑ nɛɛ, kɑɑ de nɛn bibun bweseru tu bɑndu di nɛn biru. Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɑ kɑ kɑ̃kɑ nɑ kɑnɑ teni mɔ̀.
Yinni Gusunɔ, wunɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔ. Wunɛn ɡɑri yi ɑ ɡeruɑ yi rɑ koorewɑ. Wunɑ ɑ mɑɑ mɑn durom mɛni nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ nɛn bweseru domɑru kuo kpɑ tɑ n bɑndu dii sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ wunɛn wuswɑɑɔ. Domi wunɑ ɑ ɡeruɑ mɛ. Kpɑ ɑ mɑɑ de domɑ te, tɑ n bu wɑ̃ɑsi sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
